title: Bound transient retries
prompt:
A read-only API returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After=30 seconds. Retry policy allows at most 3 total attempts. Attempt 1 just failed; no other attempts have run. Plan the next action.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. action: wait_then_retry or retry_immediately; wait_seconds: integer; attempts_remaining: integer.
remediation_hints: Respect the service delay and count attempts rather than retrying indefinitely.
